title: dombeya cincinnata var. stuhlmannii
intro: Dombeya cincinnata var. stuhlmannii, commonly known as the Stuhlmann's wild rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sterculiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and wounds, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dombeya cincinnata var. stuhlmannii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and promote wound healing. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
